outcome: age at introduction of complementary food
cohort: 435 mothers with infants from birth to six months old, attending postnatal care at public sector primary health care facilities in Emalahleni and Mbombela health subdistricts
finding: Implementation of the Baby-Friendly Hospital Initiative (BFHI) in a health subdistrict was associated with more optimal infant feeding practices in mothers with infants aged six months and younger.
